text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Wishing to be reborn as a true king, the 
"Overlord" awaited Poseidon, god of the 
sea... And at that moment!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
What appeared was not a sea god—but a 
phantom bird. One wing of the "Golden 
Generation," El Condor Pasa. She had come 
as an emissary to teach the way to fight!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I face her pro wrestling moves head-on. 
And then I realize... this is how a 
champion fights! One who cowers before 
relentless marking is no true powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And so, I learned the fighting style of an 
"Overlord"—nay! The "End of the Century 
Overlord"!
